scope.purpose: Record expert follow-up on m_csa:497 label validity and TM-pair verification for m_csa:428, m_csa:440, and m_csa:477.

m_csa_497_label_review.expert_recommendation: Relabel m_csa:497 from flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase to out_of_scope.
m_csa_497_label_review.mechanism_rationale: Flavodiiron nitric oxide reductase / FprA-FDP chemistry is centered at a non-heme Fe(II)Fe(II) carboxylate-bridged active site. FMNH2 donates electrons to the di-iron nitrosyl complex but is not the catalytic hydride-transfer locus represented by v1 flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase.
m_csa_497_label_review.curated_mechanism_text_summary: The M-CSA mechanism describes a resting Fe(II)Fe(II) center coordinating two NO molecules, forming a diferrous dinitrosyl complex. FMNH2 reduces that complex; Tyr195 and His25 protonate nitrosyl oxygen atoms, yielding N2O and H2O while restoring the diferrous center.

why_not_v1_primary_fingerprints.flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase: Mismatch: flavin is an electron donor to the di-iron site, not the catalytic hydride-transfer locus.

identity_confirmation.protein: Type A flavoprotein FprA / Flavoprotein A
identity_confirmation.family: flavodiiron protein / FNOR-like nitric oxide reductase
identity_confirmation.ec_state: EC 1.-.-.- / effectively unassigned in cited review context

eval_impact.reported_primary_metric_sensitivity: Pulling one row changes the 45-row primary support by about 1/45, approximately 2.2 percentage points before metric recomputation.
eval_impact.reason: Using m_csa:497 as geometry-correct/Foldseek-wrong would penalize models that recognize metal-centered chemistry if the current broad flavin label is wrong.

m_csa_497_label_review.required_next_step_for_label_change: Run an explicit gated label-state revision/import decision if Vivek accepts the relabel recommendation.

m_csa:428.caveat: Most TM>=0.70 neighborhood is OOS TIM-barrel glycosidase-like; primary hits are incidental TIM-barrel structural matches, not a clean same-fold primary mechanism conflict.

m_csa:440.reclassification: Move from fold-conflict candidate to near-orphan OOS / Foldseek-router-abstention diagnostic.

m_csa:477.note: Cleanest Packet 1 adversarial fold-conflict case; six distinct primary M-CSA entries confirm the structural neighborhood.
